marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind east 10 to 15 knots increasing to east 20 to 25 this
afternoon and to east 25 to 30 early this evening. Wind east 25 to 30
Sunday. Periods of snow today and this evening. Periods of snow
overnight and Sunday. Risk of freezing rain overnight and Sunday morning.
Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures minus 3 falling to minus 8 Sunday
evening. Over open water freezing spray beginning Sunday
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 near noon
Sunday.<br/>
